quest.title: Further Observation
quest.description: You can't be said to have really settled into rehabilitation at Gandharva Ville yet, but you can still ask Collei for some information.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x575, Mora x22775, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.title: Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Alright, next let's see your right hand... Hmm, not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: But please remember that you still need to be careful, understand?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Yes, I will. By the way, Master, I still haven't received the patrol route for today.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Look, Collei, today's patrol will be a long one, so you won't be coming along this time. Besides, there's a chance we may encounter... Well, you understand.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: But I have a Vision, too! Am I useless to everyone now...?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Don't talk like that, Collei. This is not something you need to be worrying about right now.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Ah, there you are. Feeling any better?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there something we can help with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, since we'll be staying here for now, we thought we might as well try lending a hand around here.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Heh, seems you're not the type to sit back and take it easy for a while, huh. In that case, perhaps Collei could take you two for a patrol south of Gandharva Ville for the day.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: And if you're feeling up to it, you can be responsible for cleaning the Statue of The Seven.

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: Tighnari, we're ready to head out!

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Got it, I'll be right there! Alright, we'll be heading into the forest now. I'll leave any further details to Collei.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Yes, you can count on me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Collei, what exactly are we going to be doing today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tighnari mentioned cleaning the statue just now, but uh... that doesn't really sound like a job for a ranger.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Well, a Forest Ranger's responsibilities can be pretty diverse.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: We handle a variety of tasks, like checking the condition of outlying roads, maintaining forest facilities, ensuring fire prevention standards are met, and providing assistance to travelers and locals.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: As for Master, well, he has to handle more dangerous areas of the rainforest.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Today we can perform routine checks on the pathway lamps as we make our way to the Statue of The Seven.

talks.objective: Check the lamps along the path
Check the lamps along the path

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Collei, we're back.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Welcome back! You must be tired after all that climbing. Let's take a little break.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, by the way, Collei, have you ever seen any small creatures scurrying around in the forest? You know... that kinda look like a veggie?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: A creature that looks like a veggie? Hmm... Well, I guess Master would say something like, "All plants are living organisms, so they also fall under the category of creatures."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Collei about the thing you saw earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Wow, fascinating! It almost sounds like an imaginary creature that you hear kids always talking about! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for anything like it.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, I almost forgot. Are you two hungry? I packed some food and water for us.

talks.objective: Check the lamps along the path

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Collei, we're back.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Welcome back! You must be tired after all that climbing. Let's take a little break now. I brought some food and water for us.

talks.objective: Go to the Statue of The Seven

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: The Statue of The Seven is up on top of that large rock formation. You must have seen it when you came down this road before.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: It's pretty high up there, isn't it? Don't worry, if you're afraid you can't make it up there, I'm sure Master wouldn't mind if you don't clean the statue.

choices.text: No need to worry. I'm a terrific climber.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh? I guess I'll leave it up to you, then. There's not much footing once you reach the statue, so be careful up there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon'll fly up with you and help with those hard-to-reach areas.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, by the way, Collei, do you know anything about the Dendro Archon? You know, what's she like?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Uhh, that depends. Are you referring to Greater Lord Rukkhadevata or Lesser Lord Kusanali?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Greater Lord Rukkhadevata?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, is that the name of the former Dendro Archon?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Uh-huh. Greater Lord Rukkhadevata was Sumeru's first Dendro Archon. She created the rainforests as well as the Wall of Samiel around the desert. Her works provided a means of peaceful living for everyone.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: To the people of Sumeru, she is not only a symbol of wisdom but also of power and kindness. Unfortunately, she disappeared in a great calamity that occurred a few hundred years ago.

choices.text: (Sounds exactly like what happened to Raiden Makoto...)

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: According to what Master has told me, the sages later found the newly born Dendro Archon and whisked her back to Sumeru.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: To celebrate the reinstatement of their lost deity, the sages dubbed her "Lesser Lord Kusanali" and let her reside in the Sanctuary of Surasthana.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh, then what happened?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Well, and then... uh... I'm not too sure what happened, to be honest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You're not too sure? But aren't you from Sumeru?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yeah, I'm from Sumeru, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe it's difficult to discuss this topic with strangers... If that's the case, then don't worry, we understand.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: No, no, it's not that. I'm not trying to hide something from you. Besides, I don't consider you two strangers.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Haha, because you two know Amber, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Amber? You mean—

choices.text: Amber, Outrider of the Knights of Favonius?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yes, that's her! I once lived in Mondstadt for a while, and she helped me a lot during that time. You could even say that she helped me become a new person.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: There's no one like Amber! She lives life to the fullest while always adhering to her strong sense of justice. She's ready to answer the call for action at any moment, but is also very understanding of others. She's like the spark that lights the fire in everyone's heart around her.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: If you ask me, she's a prime example of a true Outrider. She's the first person anyone coming to Mondstadt will meet. You can't help but be enthralled by her charm and enthusiasm, causing you to fall in love with the lands of Mondstadt, and...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Uhh, hehe... Sorry...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, Paimon thought the work of Outriders was a little different from what you just described, but one thing's for sure... you really like Amber.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Ahem... S—Sorry, I was just rambling on just now. It must have sounded kinda weird.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, it's alright, Collei. Knowing that you're a friend of Amber somehow makes Paimon suddenly feel a lot closer to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, how did you know that we've met Amber?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Well, after I returned to Sumeru, Amber and I have stayed in touch by writing each other letters.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: In one letter, she mentioned that Mondstadt was attacked by a fearsome dragon, but the city was saved by a mysterious blond traveler and their floating companion.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I knew you two were the ones she mentioned in the letter the moment I saw you. But, uh, considering everything you'd been through that day, I thought it'd be inappropriate to bring it up...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, so that's how you knew!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yep! So please know that you two have my complete trust, really.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I wish I could tell you more about the Dendro Archon, but I had been away from Sumeru for some time, and I haven't read any books... Sorry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's alright! You've already helped us a lot, we had never even heard of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata or the Sanctuary of Surasthana until you mentioned them.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh, I'm happy that was helpful. There is one thing I want to ask, though... Why do you two want to know about the Dendro Archon?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain the purpose of your journey to Collei.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: So that's why you're here. Thank you for telling me your story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't mention it! We are friends after all, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon's right, we're friends.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! Alright, we have a statue to clean!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: You both have my thanks! While you two are up there cleaning, I'll go ahead and inspect the forest canopy. Let's meet back here shortly.

choices.text: Wow, we've never seen this side of you, Collei...

talks.objective: Climb to the top of the rock
Resonate with the Dendro Archon Statue

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Resonate with Dendro

talks.objective: Examine the Dendro Archon Statue before you

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, now that Paimon looks at it, the deity that's carved on the statue is... kinda small.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, do you think she's supposed to be Greater Lord Rukkhadevata or Lesser Lord Kusanali?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You might be right. The statue does look kinda old, hmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, anyway, we'll have to figure that out later. For now, let's focus on our job and clean up this—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Wait a sec! Is it just Paimon, or was there something moving!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It was kinda small and round... You know, like a vegetable or something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It really freaked Paimon out! Whatever it was, we should probably go and investigate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh actually, on second thought, maybe we should get to cleaning first. Paimon'll fly up and take care of the top, and you clean everything below.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon meticulously clean the statue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's it! Small and round like cabbage... but moving!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The name does seem to fit the statue somehow. Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay, food! What kind of goodies did you bring!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, some restraint, please...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, don't be a party pooper! It's not like Collei is a stranger or anything. Besides, the best way to compliment a chef is to show passion for their food! Xiangling taught Paimon that.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I prepared a nice, portable dish that Forest Rangers like to eat, called Pita Pockets. I hope you'll like them...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Wh—Whoops!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: AH! Nooo!!! You dropped it on the ground!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Not to worry! I wrapped a few layers of oiled paper around each pita. They should be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, whew... Paimon nearly had a heart attack there.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You enjoy the pitas together with Collei.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those pitas are amazing! You're quite the cook, Collei.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank goodness you wrapped them in paper... Paimon wouldn't be able to sleep at night knowing something so tasty had been wasted.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Haha, you really know how to compliment the chef, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Since you liked it so much, I'll be sure to give you a copy of the recipe sometime. I'll even include all my personal cooking pointers, so you'll be making your own Pita Pockets in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay thanks, Collei! It's hard to believe someone as diligent as you could have clumsy moments too.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, hehe... I guess it happens from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So uh, Collei... Don't you think that Tighnari's a little too strict with you? He won't let you touch anything without his permission.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon knocks stuff over all the time flying around the Traveler, but {NICKNAME}'s never said anything. Everyone has their clumsy moments!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: No no, you've got the wrong idea about Master. Sure, he may seem a bit harsh at first. With some time, you'll see that he's actually very kindhearted.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I've heard the veteran rangers say that Master is from some ancient and mysterious race that is known for their cunning wit and reclusive nature. But Master is actually very kind at heart.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way, you've heard of the Akademiya, right? Well, there's a group called Am... uh, Amu something...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Well, anyway, because Master does a lot of research on plants, sages from the Akademiya have written him many times, inviting him to take up an official position there.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: But Master declines their offers every time, saying, "Sumeru City is too noisy. It'd be bad for my ears."

choices.text: That does sound like something Tighnari would say...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Haha, seems you already know him well. Anyway, I'm sure the sages were not happy about his responses.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Master could obviously have a bright future in the Akademiya, but he insists on sticking to the path of a Forest Watcher. Every day, he helps the locals of the forest and passes on his extensive knowledge to trainees like me.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: In fact, Master's the one who taught me how to make Pita Pockets.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Paimon would've never guessed that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, speaking of Tighnari, he was the one who took care of you after finding you passed out yesterday. He even carried you all the way here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's still kinda upset, though! He kept scolding Paimon the entire way here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you do?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh no, I'm sorry. Master might've been overreacting a little...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: #But it's mostly because Paimon wouldn't stop yelling, "Why, oh why!? Is {M#he}{F#she} going to die!?" It probably started to get under Master's skin after a while.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Argh, don't laugh!!! Paimon was genuinely concerned about you!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Pfft! Hehehe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Now even Collei's starting to laugh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ughhh! That's it! Paimon won't forget this! It's time for some Paimonial wrath!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: No! Don't touch me!!!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Sorry, Collei! Paimon didn't mean to scare you...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Ah, no I just... I—I didn't mean that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Collei, are you okay? What's the matter?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: No uh, I—I'm fine. I'm sorry, I must've startled you both reacting like that.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh, well it's getting late now. Uh, let's hurry back to Gandharva Ville. I think Master and the others should be back by now, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, what was up with Collei just now? And why's she in such a hurry all of a sudden...? Look, she's practically running back. Paimon can't even see her now!

choices.text: Speaking of his ears... I'd really like to pet them!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Hehehe, I know, right! I've always wanted to pet them, too. Ahem...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Anyway, Master could have easily left the rainforest to take up a position at the Akademiya. But he chose to stay here instead as a Forest Watcher, helping the locals every day and passing on his knowledge to trainees.

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, you've returned.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, we're back. Uh, have you seen Collei by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Nasrin
dialogues.text: Oh, Collei? Yes, I saw her go into her room just a moment ago.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, okay... Guess we'll just have to wait and talk to her tomorrow then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, now that Paimon looks at it, the deity that's carved on the statue is... kinda small.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, do you think she's supposed to be Greater Lord Rukkhadevata or Lesser Lord Kusanali?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You might be right. The statue does look kinda old, hmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, anyway, we'll have to figure that out later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's get started on cleaning the statue. Paimon'll fly up and take care of the top, and you clean everything below.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon meticulously clean the statue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The name does seem to fit the statue somehow. Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Uh, I'm not a very good climber, so I'll just let you handle the statue.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I'll go check the facilities up ahead. By the way, once we're done with our work here... would you like to chat some more?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Rise and shine! C'mon, it's time to go find Collei.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Hmm, no problems with this lamp. Good.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Dendro Archon's Statue of The Seven is up there. You should try touching it like the other ones we've found on our journey.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon bets you'll definitely get a response from the Dendro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice work, that's one clean statue! Let's head down and meet up with Collei.
